answer: Make admission costly and checkable. Each new identity must lock a fixed POA bond, released only after two consecutive epochs in which its answer draws at least eight established attesters who do not share an invite ancestor within k hops. If peers mark the text as a duplicate or template, the bond is burned, not refunded, so a sybil mill pays both time and capital for every extra name. Crossing a cold ocean toward a tundra research plot, a surveyor still counts each juniper once, however many paper tags hang from the same trunk.
